description: Search one country's listed businesses by words, category, town or region, and what the page carries. Returns up to 24 a page, each with its Nearwick page address to cite. Results are A to Z, or newest details first.

category.description: A category or group slug from list_categories, such as "pharmacies".

city.description: A town or city, such as "Accra".

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, such as GH for Ghana or CA for Canada.

has.description: Only pages that carry all of these: a website, opening hours, a map pin.

managed.description: Only businesses that manage their own page.

query.description: Words in the name, description or address, such as "pharmacy" or a business name.

sort.description: "name" (A to Z, the default) or "recent" (newest details first).

name: search_businesses
title: Search businesses
